yearTreatment: concrete digits in a sculpture courtyard
creativeDirection: Daylight location photography of a real modern sculpture courtyard, using large physical concrete year digits as the lead subject and translating the album-cover motifs into installed artworks, portraits, surfaces, and planted details around them.
scene: A sun-struck modern museum sculpture courtyard seen almost face-on from a slightly elevated viewpoint, with huge freestanding concrete digits reading 2025 dominating the center of the frame. The courtyard is clean, geometric, and open to the sky, with white walls, pale paving, a few planted beds, and room for distinct art objects and portraits around the digits without crowding them.

elements.element: a large luminous blue glass lightbox or shallow reflecting panel set low behind part of the digits, with a single small star-like point of light above it
the woman from reference image 2 staged as a side-profile portrait installation at the left side of the courtyard, facing left, with the same smeared magenta and purple paint across her face and hair

the two young girls from reference image 3 posed closely together near a planted bed, smiling as in the source, with a white chair in the left foreground nearby and an orange patterned wall panel behind them
a large sepia photographic mosaic mural on one courtyard wall, forming one central face from many overlapping image fragments
an orange crescent-like sculpture mounted or leaning near the digits, intersected by a thin horizontal light bar
the two young men from reference image 6 staged together as a black-and-white portrait within the courtyard, chest-up, looking directly at camera, preserving their original pose and styling

the man from reference image 7 standing frontally near an orange architectural wall with skewed window frames, his face partly obscured by white, red, and black painterly marks carried into nearby surface treatments
a stark white wall area with a short horizontal black line rendered as a minimal installed mark

coverSummaries.description: A dark, nearly black image with a large soft-edged glowing blue rectangular form filling most of the lower and central area. Near the upper right of the glow is a small bright star-like point with a cross-shaped flare. The composition is minimal and abstract, with the blue light fading into deep navy and black around the edges.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: small star-like light over a glowing blue field
coverSummaries.medium: abstract digital photograph or light-based image

coverSummaries.description: A close side-profile portrait of one woman facing left against a black background. Thick smeared paint in vivid magenta and purple is dragged across her face and hair, partially obscuring her features and extending horizontally across the image. The skin is rendered in muted gray-green tones beneath the glossy paint texture.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: woman's profile covered in smeared neon paint
coverSummaries.people: one woman in side profile facing left

coverSummaries.description: A stylized image of two young girls close together, smiling, tinted in pink and purple. A white chair occupies the left foreground, cropped large. The upper background is a flat orange field filled with a repeating floral or radial pattern, while darker foliage appears behind the girls.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: two young girls posed closely together
coverSummaries.medium: tinted photograph with graphic patterned background
coverSummaries.people: two young girls smiling close together

coverSummaries.album: Metropolis Pt 2 Scenes From a Memory
coverSummaries.description: A sepia-toned collage dominated by a large central human face built from many overlapping photographs and fragments. Smaller images of faces, figures, interiors, and objects are layered throughout, creating a dense mosaic. The overall composition is dark around the edges with warm amber highlights concentrated in the center.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: large face formed from a collage of many photographs
coverSummaries.people: many people shown in overlapping photographic fragments, centered on one large face

coverSummaries.description: A dark textured background in black and deep red with a large orange crescent-like circular symbol centered vertically. Behind and around it are decorative curling calligraphic forms in darker red. A thin glowing horizontal line cuts across the middle, intersecting the central symbol.

A black-and-white studio portrait of two young men shown from the chest up against a plain light background. One stands slightly behind on the left with dark voluminous hair and an earring, wearing a dark zippered jacket. The other is in front on the right with curly dark hair, wearing a textured knit sweater. Both look directly at the camera with neutral expressions.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: close black-and-white portrait of two men
coverSummaries.people: two young men in a close studio portrait

coverSummaries.description: A graphic collage featuring a man in a black suit and tie centered against an orange architectural backdrop with skewed window frames on both sides. His face is partly obscured and fragmented by white, red, and black painterly marks and smoke-like textures. The top portion is white with scattered paper scraps, stamps, and diagram-like markings, giving the whole image a mixed-media poster feel.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: suited man with face obscured by abstract paint and collage
coverSummaries.people: one man in a suit standing frontally

coverSummaries.description: A stark minimalist white cover with only centered black typographic elements and a short horizontal line. There are no pictorial objects, figures, or scenery, just empty white space and simple black marks.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: short horizontal black line in a blank white field

prompt: Huge freestanding concrete digits reading "2025" dominate the center of a modern open-air sculpture courtyard, seen almost face-on from a slightly elevated viewpoint so the year reads clearly and spans most of the frame; around and behind the digits, build a bright realistic museum-like setting with pale paving, white walls, clean planted beds, and carefully staged art objects and portraits. Behind part of the year, place a large glowing blue glass light field with a single small star-like point above it from reference image 1; at the left side of the courtyard stage the woman from reference image 2 exactly in her left-facing side profile with the same hair, expression, and smeared neon magenta-purple paint across her face and hair; near an orange patterned wall panel place the two young girls from reference image 3 smiling close together, with a large white chair cropped into the left foreground; on a rear wall create a sepia mural from reference image 4, one large face formed from many overlapping photographic fragments; add the large orange crescent-like symbol from reference image 5 as a physical sculpture intersected by a thin horizontal light bar; stage the two young men from reference image 6 together chest-up, preserving their direct gaze, pose, hair, and clothing like a black-and-white portrait brought into the courtyard; place the man from reference image 7 standing frontally by an orange architectural section with skewed window frames, with white, red, and black painterly fragmentation obscuring his face as in the source; include reference image 8 as a stark white wall with a short horizontal black line. Photographic realism, daylight location photography, crisp lens rendering, no haze, no fog, no wet surfaces, no text overlays. Strong visual hierarchy with the concrete year first, album motifs as supporting installations around it. Hard midday sun with sharp shadows, clean saturated color, bright white architecture, concrete gray, electric blue, orange, magenta, sepia, black, graphic and celebratory mood. The year "2025" appears exactly once as concrete digits in a sculpture courtyard, built into the scene and lit like the rest of the photograph. It is the dominant subject and the first thing the eye reads: the digits span at least half the width of the frame, sit high or centred rather than along the bottom edge, and read face-on and legibly at thumbnail size, with the album motifs and people arranged around it. Reference map for people (the album images are attached in this numbered order): reference image 2 shows one woman in side profile facing left; reference image 3 shows two young girls smiling close together; reference image 4 shows many people shown in overlapping photographic fragments, centered on one large face; reference image 6 shows two young men in a close studio portrait; reference image 7 shows one man in a suit standing frontally. Copy each of these faces directly from that numbered reference image - same face, hair, expression, and styling - rather than drawing a new person from the description. Hard constraints (override any conflicting source material): Create a single cohesive 16:9 image, not a grid, contact sheet, row of covers, or collage of separate panels. Do not reproduce the album sleeves as framed thumbnails; transform their non-text visual motifs into one original composition. The only lettering anywhere in the image is the year "2025": those four digits, spelled exactly 2 0 2 5, appearing once, large and legible, as a physical part of the scene rather than an overlay. Include no other readable text or lettering of any kind: no other words, letters, numbers, dates, code, glyphs, captions, titles, logos, watermarks, labels, or signage. Feature only adults and avoid gore, wounds, body horror, medical or anatomical imagery, blank or milky eyes, nudity, sexual content, weapons, and hate symbols; reinterpret any sensitive source motif abstractly. When a source includes a person, closely match their visible appearance and likeness to the reference image, preserving recognisable facial features, hair, skin tone, clothing, and styling. Keep each reference person in the pose, expression, and gaze the sleeve shows, and keep every identifiable face sharp, lit, unobscured, and in focus: no motion blur, long-exposure smearing, steam, fog, shadow, crowding, or shallow depth of field over a reference person's face. Expose the image brightly and cleanly: open, readable shadows and clear colour, with no murky underexposure, crushed blacks, heavy film grain, digital noise, or dust-and-scratches texture. Depict each identifiable reference person only once in the entire composition; do not repeat or clone them as another figure, reflection, mirror portrait, poster, billboard, screen, photograph, painting, silhouette, or background face. The only exception is repetition visibly intrinsic to one source cover: keep that repetition within that single source motif and do not echo the person elsewhere.
